Class GdalDataset

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.gdal.GdalDataset
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class GdalDataset extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A dataset of GDAL: a raster (bands of pixels with georeferencing) and/or vector layers. Close it after use (try-with-resources).
